id, workspace_id, design_id, version_no, status, source_version_id, design_sha256, html_oss_ref, html_sha256, html_size, renderer_version, summary, change_summary, requirement_count, open_question_count, blocking_question_count, ai_session_id, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, confirmed_sha256, is_deleted, deleted_at, version, creator_id, modifier_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prd_design_version (workspace_id, design_id, version_no, status, source_version_id, design_json, design_sha256, html_oss_ref, html_sha256, html_size, renderer_version, summary, change_summary, requirement_count, open_question_count, blocking_question_count, ai_session_id, is_deleted, version, creator_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{designId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{designJson}, #{designSha256}, #{htmlOssRef}, #{htmlSha256}, #{htmlSize}, #{rendererVersion}, #{summary}, #{changeSummary}, #{requirementCount}, #{openQuestionCount}, #{blockingQuestionCount}, #{aiSessionId}, 0, 0, #{creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM prd_design_version WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT FROM prd_design_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND design_id = #{designId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT FROM prd_design_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND design_id = #{designId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM prd_design_version WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ai_session_id = #{aiSessionId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE prd_design_version SET design_json = #{v.designJson}, design_sha256 = #{v.designSha256}, html_oss_ref = #{v.htmlOssRef}, html_sha256 = #{v.htmlSha256}, html_size = #{v.htmlSize}, renderer_version = #{v.rendererVersion}, summary = #{v.summary}, change_summary = #{v.changeSummary}, requirement_count = #{v.requirementCount}, open_question_count = #{v.openQuestionCount}, blocking_question_count = #{v.blockingQuestionCount}, version = version + 1 , modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{v.id} AND workspace_id = #{v.workspaceId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE prd_design_version SET html_oss_ref = #{htmlOssRef}, html_sha256 = #{htmlSha256}, html_size = #{htmlSize} WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE prd_design_version SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = NOW(3), confirmed_sha256 = #{confirmedSha256}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status <> 'CONFIRMED' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE prd_design_version SET is_deleted = 1, deleted_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 , modifier_id = #{modifierId} WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status <> 'CONFIRMED' AND is_deleted = 0
